summary: Deployment-readiness backend verification: 10/10 pytest cases passed. Verified both health endpoints, admin JWT auth (/api/auth/login + /api/auth/me), 3 plans with prices 69/99/129 (field name is price_brl), tenant-scoped /api/clientes, system reset preview + validation (short motivo and wrong confirmacao both return 400), and comissoes DELETE protection (400 for paid, 200 for non-paid). The deployment_agent PASS verdict is confirmed from the backend side.

minor.issue: Root-level /health is only reachable through the backend internally (http://localhost:8001/health -> {"status":"ok"}). The external REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL/health returns the SPA index.html because the K8s ingress routes only /api/* to the backend. This is correct for the in-pod K8s liveness probe (which is what the deployment logs reflect) but it means /health cannot be probed from outside the cluster. Not a bug, just a note.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now very large (DELETE /api/comissoes at ~L568, PLANS at ~L1033, system reset endpoints near the bottom) — recommend splitting into routers (auth, plans, clientes, comissoes, system) once stable to keep each file < 700 lines.
/api/plans exposes price under the key `price_brl` (not `price`). Make sure the frontend pricing page and any Stripe lookup logic use `price_brl` consistently; otherwise prices will render as 0.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded admin + demo data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_deployment_health.py covers health + auth + plans + clientes + system/reset + comissoes delete protection. /health is validated against http://localhost:8001 (not the external URL) because K8s ingress only routes /api/* to backend; this matches how the K8s liveness probe actually calls it. Plan price field is `price_brl`.
rca of the issue: User's reported deploy-log errors are two single-shot 'Connection refused' entries emitted by nginx while probing /health during the ~5s uvicorn boot window — followed by hundreds of 200 OK responses. The two 'Started server process' lines ([25] and [26]) come from two independent deployment runs merged in the same log view, not a crash loop. All target endpoints are healthy in the preview env, so the deployment is ready to roll out.
